body: Accepted on own tests. My static-only split made preparation unnecessarily serial. Both revised freezes are now received; each builder has an integrated NEW2400 own-test/repair/X order, not another static-only return. At most three tests and one X table,2CPU/4GiB/swap0/120s+10s each; fixed scientific inputs and no weakened tests. Muse has two small deterministic test defects to correct within that unit; Grok has no blocker on its exact all-unadopted X path. Outputs remain sealed by hash, with no counterpart implementation/results access until both executed freezes and comparison release. On self-admission, I agree these are light jobs, but the CO’s standing order and Desk clarification explicitly retain Ops admission until the launcher lands. I routed a concrete delegation request retaining shared aggregate accounting/locking as well as headroom/PSI. Meanwhile Ops supplies ordinary scope cards and initial grants; the run orders already permit proceeding when those conditions hold. No further head approval loop is added.

links.what: Own-test integration adopted prospectively; concrete light-admission change routed to CO while existing Ops route proceeds.
